warnings.title: Reduced-motion disables the pipe highlight entirely, contradicting the documented 'steady band'
warnings.detail: spawn_fx_draw_highlight early-returns under reduced_motion while the file header (:28), the proc comment, and the PR body (:57-58) promise a steady band (the pulse_read 'presence, not motion' precedent). Ring and reveal keep static readings; the highlight alone loses presence.
warnings.recommended_fix: Draw the steady band at fixed alpha under reduced_motion (skip only the k-fade), or amend the three comments/PR body to state suppression.

warnings.title: Type-chip hairline fade reintroduces the rlsw line-alpha trap during the reveal
warnings.detail: The software renderer ignores line alpha: goldens capture the hairline solid through the reveal while the GPU app fades it — live-vs-capture divergence for 8 ticks per spawn. The pre-change code deliberately kept this line full-alpha.
warnings.recommended_fix: Keep the hairline full-alpha through the reveal (fade fills only), or draw the outline as four alpha-blended filled rects.

warnings.title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy are dead code; reveals latches the ambient allocator and is never torn down
warnings.detail: Zero call sites repo-wide (grep-verified; only spawn_fx_reset is called: app/main.odin:741, harness/run.odin:293). Empirical: `+++ leak 192B @ spawn_fx.odin:146:spawn_fx_feed()`; render suite carries 3,794 tracker leak lines.
warnings.recommended_fix: Wire init/destroy into the View lifecycle (app init/exit + harness Render_Ctx), or delete the procs and document the latch-on-append pattern.

warnings.title: shadow_clone completeness guard cannot catch future non-serialized dynamic fields

The residual risk (a future missed field aliases live memory and run_destroy frees it) stands.
warnings.recommended_fix: Extend the round-trip pin to walk field metadata, or a construction-time contract naming every dynamic field.

warnings.title: Reveal-buffer >4 trim boundary has no test
warnings.detail: No unit test or golden forces >4 live reveals: feed tests assert len==1 and len==2, and spawn_feel.dem spawns exactly 4 nodes (buffer never exceeds 4), so the ordered_remove trim never executes in any suite.
warnings.recommended_fix: Feed 5+ NODE_SPAWNED events in one slice; assert len(reveals)==4 and the OLDEST ids dropped.

warnings.title: Reduced-motion telegraph ring and highlight draw paths untested (no growth-enabled reduced-motion golden)

notes.title: Telegraph timeline guard wraps u64 when terminal_spawn_interval_ticks < 10
notes.detail: T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS underflows for T < 10; the catalog enforces only interval >= 1 (catalog.odin:842), so a modded cadence 1..9 hits it. Unreachable at the shipped 80-tick cadence.

notes.recommended_fix: Guard: expect interval >= 15, testing.errorf + early return.

notes.title: sfx_load_cat's read1 prints the read error then returns nil, dropping the error (misleading symptoms downstream)
notes.detail: Tests then run against a zeroed catalog, reporting catalog symptoms (or the interval-wrap hang) instead of the IO cause.
notes.recommended_fix: Return (b, ok); testing.errorf at the top of each test before touching the catalog.
